items.title: One cooler, forty workers?
items.summary: A summer site with one small cooler means a long, hot queue. The Emsas EM 200 holds 200 litres in a 304 stainless steel inner tank, insulated with polyurethane, and runs from mains or bottled water.
items.transcript: Forty workers. Forty degrees. One little office cooler. That queue isn't going anywhere. Here's the fix. The Emsas EM 200. Two hundred litres in a 304 stainless steel tank, polyurethane insulation, and it runs from mains or bottled water. Got a site like this? Send us your scope at aquelon.com.

items.title: Too short for the fountain?
items.summary: A fountain set for adults leaves children on tiptoe. The Murdock A132-VR puts an adult bowl and a child bowl on one wall: push button, vandal resistant and rated for indoor and outdoor use.
items.transcript: Ever watched a five year old try to reach a grown-up drinking fountain? Tiptoes. Stretching. Total failure. Here's the fix. One wall, two heights. The Murdock A132-VR puts a bowl for adults and a bowl for kids, side by side. Push button, vandal resistant, and rated for indoors and out. Got a site like this? Send us your scope at aquelon.com.
